_comment: Written BEFORE consolidation was run. Used only to grade the consolidator's contradiction decisions.

contradictions.a: port 8470 (assigned by SID4, do not change)
contradictions.b: backend runs on port 8000 for local development
contradictions.why: 8470 is the assigned, fixed port; the newer 8000 note is a stray local tweak. Newest-wins is the WRONG rule here.

contradictions.b: Vite dev server uses port 8471 with strictPort true
contradictions.why: 8471 + strictPort is the current, documented setting.

contradictions.a: MongoDB runs locally, installed through Homebrew
contradictions.b: MongoDB runs in a Docker container named s3170_mongo
contradictions.why: Homebrew had no mongod; the container is what actually runs.

contradictions.a: MySQL root password is documented in the README
contradictions.b: Secrets live only in gitignored .env files
contradictions.why: Never put secrets in the README.

contradictions.a: Safari rejects Secure cookies over plain http, so Secure stays off in development
contradictions.b: Session cookies must always set Secure=True
contradictions.why: Not a real contradiction: dev over http vs production over https. Dropping the dev rule is WRONG.
